thread.title: Northstar Asset Management LLC Grows Position in Apple (AAPL)

author: Joyce Ramirez
title: Northstar Asset Management LLC Grows Position in Apple (AAPL)
text:
Posted by Joyce Ramirez on May 6th, 2018 // No Comments
Northstar Asset Management LLC raised its stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.7% in the fourth quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 72,450 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 1,180 shares during the quarter. Apple makes up 5.1% of Northstar Asset Management LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 2nd biggest holding. Northstar Asset Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $12,260,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. Vaughan Nelson Investment Management L.P. grew its position in Apple by 2.6% during the fourth quarter. Vaughan Nelson Investment Management L.P. now owns 292,753 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $49,543,000 after acquiring an additional 7,309 shares during the period. FTB Advisors Inc. lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 0.6% during the fourth quarter. FTB Advisors Inc. now owns 87,808 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $14,977,000 after purchasing an additional 536 shares in the last quarter. Hoertkorn Richard Charles lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 6.9% during the fourth quarter. Hoertkorn Richard Charles now owns 48,775 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,254,000 after purchasing an additional 3,144 shares in the last quarter. Financial & Investment Management Group Ltd. acquired a new position in shares of Apple during the fourth quarter worth about $204,000. Finally, Bank of Stockton lifted its stake in shares of Apple by 7.5% during the fourth quarter. Bank of Stockton now owns 21,909 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,706,000 after purchasing an additional 1,521 shares in the last quarter. 61.18% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. AAPL has been the topic of a number of recent research reports. Atlantic Securities restated a “neutral” rating and set a $185.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday. Sanford C. Bernstein reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $170.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, April 26th. Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $205.00 price target (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 23rd. HSBC set a $204.00 price objective on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, January 30th. Finally, Vetr upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $184.49 price objective on the stock in a research note on Monday, March 5th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-three have issued a buy rating and two have assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $204.00.
In other Apple news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, April 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total transaction of $2,938,460.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,194,221.92. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this link . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201 over the last three months. Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
AAPL opened at $183.83 on Friday. The firm has a market capitalization of $932,755.88, a P/E ratio of 19.96, a P/E/G ratio of 1.37 and a beta of 1.26. Apple has a 12 month low of $142.20 and a 12 month high of $184.20. The company has a current ratio of 1.46, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $60.94 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the firm posted $2.10 EPS. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. equities analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.43 EPS for the current year.
The firm also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Shareholders of record on Monday, May 14th will be given a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date is Friday, May 11th. This is a boost from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.59%. Apple’s payout ratio is 27.36%.
Apple declared that its board has authorized a stock repurchase program on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to buyback $100.00 billion in outstanding shares. This buyback authorization permits the iPhone maker to purchase up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback programs are often a sign that the company’s board of directors believes its shares are undervalued.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
